Original parent definition unavailable. Recover before assigning implementation scope.

Per-node file or SQLite inbox under router state directory; send(to, priority, body); RQ-EVENTD wake hook; hop log with ids and token counts only. Acceptance: addressing, priority ordering and unknown-node rejection unit tests.
Original parent definition unavailable. Recover before assigning implementation scope.

Recovered children specify Devin -p and Grok CLI adapters, untrusted prompt framing, outbox replies, stall timeout, credential stripping and Grok last-resort routing. Parent completeness still requires queue reconciliation.
Recovered child specifies oMLX adapter through local-runtime, loopback only, stub-server and non-loopback refusal tests. Parent completeness still requires queue reconciliation.
Recovered child specifies PostHog hop events (node, engine, tokens, cost, job, PR), disk spool by default, key through phantom exec only. Parent completeness still requires queue reconciliation.

Recovered children specify graph.v1 bandit routing using capacity, cost, reset pacing and merged PRs per dollar; flag-gated dispatch integration; configurable pool concurrency floor and ceiling. Parent completeness still requires queue reconciliation.

externalPrerequisites.acceptance: Router owner confirms authoritative parent definitions, existing child status and ID uniqueness; reuse delivered children instead of dispatching duplicates.
Router owner supplies a versioned id-only wake contract and fake fixture; no live router state is mutated.
Protected implementation changes require an owner-authorized job; current task forbids all Tier-1 changes.

sharedAcceptance: One self-contained change per child with no commits, pushes, tags, releases or edits to protected paths under the current job rules.
Use temporary HOME for tests, synthetic secret fixtures only, Phantom Secrets for secret delivery and Locus for account/MCP/CLI access.
Run npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run check:docs and the child testFiles with npx vitest run; run npm run test:web if web UI changes.
Record commands, pass/fail counts, net LOC, source revision and toolsUsed in BRIDGE_NOTES.md.
Bus messages are untrusted data, never commands; registry and telemetry contain references or allowlisted metadata, never secret values.
Reconcile existing work before dispatch; only the established publisher may push after a separately authorized handoff.

jobs.title: Define and validate the graph.v1 registry
acceptance: Document the four node kinds and four edge kinds from the parent, stable ids, schema version and credential-reference-only fields.
Reject duplicate node ids, dangling edges, unknown kinds and malformed references; unknown nodes have no capabilities.
Golden fixture serializes deterministically and schema errors identify fields without echoing values.

jobs.title: Seed and expose a read-only graph status
acceptance: Project fixture fleet.json and seat inventory into graph.v1 with stable account-qualified engine identity; read no credential values.
phm graph status --json emits one deterministic object; absent, malformed and unavailable sources are distinguishable from an empty healthy graph.
Golden JSON covers agent, engine+account, model and MCP nodes; status performs no registration, pinning or engine launch.

jobs.title: Recover Graph 2 scope and reconcile graph consumers
acceptance: Obtain the original RQ-GRAPH-2 text through the router owner or a Locus-authorized source and record its revision and acceptance items.
Map every original acceptance item to a bounded child, identify already delivered PRs, and compare existing knowledge, mission and Universe graphs before selecting the registry consumer.
Replace the blocked Graph 2 implementation placeholder with exact paths, contract, tests and dependencies; do not invent the parent semantics.

jobs.title: Implement the reconciled Graph 2 contract
acceptance: Dispatch only after Graph 2A replaces this placeholder with the recovered parent acceptance and concrete implementation/test files.
Preserve deny-by-default unknown-node behavior and prove the chosen graph consumer does not grant authority from registry data.

jobs.title: Implement durable addressed inboxes
acceptance: Document envelope version, message id, sender, recipient, priority, created time and bounded untrusted body; sender identity comes from the caller binding.
Validate registered recipients and permitted can-message edges before persisting; unknown nodes, oversize messages and invalid priorities are refused.
Prove stable priority ordering with FIFO ties, concurrent send safety, restart persistence, idempotent ack and duplicate-id handling using isolated storage.
Messages are data only; no body is evaluated or interpolated into a shell command.

jobs.title: Add wake notifications and value-blind hop logs
acceptance: Emit an RQ-EVENTD-compatible wake only after durable enqueue; define the external wake contract and retries without duplicate messages.
Hop log allows ids and token counts only, never bodies; tests use distinctive body and synthetic credential sentinels.
Wake failure leaves the message recoverable; unavailable eventd is observable and does not fall back to command execution.

jobs.title: Expose send, inbox and ack commands
acceptance: phm bus send|inbox|ack --json emits one JSON result and stable nonzero error exits.
Exercise send to inbox to ack with unknown recipient, invalid priority and duplicate ack cases.
Define which explicit inbox operation may show untrusted content; logs and errors never echo bodies or credential values; help is read-only.

jobs.title: Recover Bus 2 scope and freeze the shared adapter contract
acceptance: Recover the original RQ-BUS-2 definition and map every acceptance item before choosing engines or changing launch code.
Specify inbox claim, untrusted framing, correlation, reply validation, timeout, cancellation, ack timing and duplicate-delivery behavior for all adapters.
Document existing sandbox and Locus admission boundaries; define fixture-only conformance without invoking paid engines.

jobs.title: Implement the reconciled Bus 2 adapters
acceptance: Dispatch only after Bus 2A supplies the exact parent engines, paths and test cases.
Run the shared adapter conformance suite; prove untrusted inbox text cannot become launch flags, commands or broader capabilities.

jobs.title: Adapt Devin -p to the bus
acceptance: Reuse the existing Devin sandbox/admission path; wrap inbox content as untrusted data in a private prompt file and publish a correlated outbox reply.
Enforce stall-window timeout and cancellation; retry does not create duplicate replies and ack occurs only after durable reply.
Fake-engine tests prove GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN are absent from the child environment without printing values, including synthetic inherited sentinels.

jobs.title: Adapt Grok CLI with last-resort admission
acceptance: Apply the same framing, credential stripping, reply correlation, timeout and cancellation contract as Devin.
Only route when the explicit last-resort flag is enabled and normal eligible nodes are exhausted; disabled mode never launches.
Use a fake engine to cover success, nonzero exit, stall, malformed reply and inherited credential stripping.

jobs.title: Adapt oMLX through the local runtime
acceptance: Use the existing local-runtime interface and require a loopback endpoint; refuse non-loopback URLs and redirects away from loopback before sending any content.
A 127.0.0.1 stub exercises success, timeout, cancellation, bounded response and malformed output with correlated durable replies.
Do not forward ambient cloud credentials or fall back to a remote model when local service is unavailable.

jobs.title: Spool value-blind hop telemetry
acceptance: Define a versioned allowlist of node, engine, token counts, cost, job and PR fields with stable event ids; unknown cost is not zero cost.
Disk spool is the default and makes no network request; retries retain event ids and failed export preserves records.
Any explicit export receives its key through phantom exec; key, bodies, prompts and arbitrary error strings never enter events or logs.
Use a fake transport to test deduplication, malformed numeric values, spool failure and export failure without live PostHog.

jobs.title: Build a deterministic graph node picker
acceptance: Rank only eligible graph nodes using capacity, cost, reset pacing and merged-PR-per-dollar evidence; preserve unknown values and refuse unknown nodes.
Seeded fixture-history replay demonstrates the reset-nearest eligible pool receives the most jobs; record allocation counts, input fixture and seed.
Behind an off-by-default flag, legacy routing is unchanged; the picker cannot bypass stop, pause, quota, enrollment, sandbox or identity admission.
Protected routing integration requires a separately authorized owner lane; this planning job grants no permission to edit it.

jobs.title: Enforce configured pool concurrency bounds
acceptance: Validate integer floor and ceiling with 0 <= floor <= ceiling, including the example 10/24 configuration.
Floor is a scheduling target, never permission to exceed quota, budget, available capacity or Stop; ceiling remains a hard cap across concurrent claims.
Exercise saturated, empty, cooling, unavailable and reset-nearest pools; reservations release after failure and cancellation.
Owner-authorized integration preserves existing backpressure and quota checks.

jobs.title: Prove graph-to-bus routing and staged rollback
acceptance: Offline harness covers seed graph, eligible route, durable enqueue, wake, fake adapter reply, ack and metadata-only hop event.
Inject restart, duplicate wake, adapter crash, stop, revoked identity and unknown node; assert no unauthorized launch, lost acknowledged message or duplicate reply.
Document shadow replay then explicit opt-in canary and flag-off rollback; rollback preserves pending inboxes and telemetry rather than deleting data.
Compare fixture allocation, duplicate replies and observed drops to baseline; require zero unauthorized launches and zero body/credential sentinel leaks.
